chart_space.definition: one-sided first derivative of the linear albedo at the periodic seam (second-order stencils on [0,2h] and [C-2h,C] with h_u=1e-5, both estimating f'(0+)=f'(C-)) compared against the same stencil measured in the interior of the chart with the same sample count; legitimate frozen kinks are budgeted, not hidden
chart_space.derivative_policy: recipe: frozen raster tile (rasterised stroke edges are C0 content)

world_space.definition: mesh faces next to the seam paired by profile coordinate; the colour step must stay under the measured field Lipschitz bound times the real arc distance
